title: Scribble-to-object Flow - user draws on the image, ControlNet + SDXL renders it in
description: Fabio, 2026-08-16. A Flow that turns the user's own DRAWING on top of their image into a rendered object stitched back into that image - a special inpaint driven by a scribble, not by a prompt alone. BENCH FIRST: author and prove the whole graph in the node graph, THEN wire it with /mpi-add-flow. No app work until the bench half is user-approved. Spec, open questions and the model/preprocessor choices: tasks/MPI-567/brief.md.
